CustomField.description: A text value for switches that carry one, e.g. KYC_FORM_DOCGEN_PACKAGE = the Nintex DocGen package name the console generates the KYC form with. Added 18 Sep 2026 (SCW-121).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional text carried by this switch (for example a Nintex package name). Blank for plain on/off switches.
CustomField.label: Value
